item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 05/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over Guangdong this week. It will be cool in the morning over the coastal areas today and tomorrow. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will be generally fine over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 05/12 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool in the morning and at night. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 60 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
